text:
Mia K: incident-bot just paged me — huge queue growth on the embeddings service in us-west2, looks like GPUs are being preempted faster than fallback can spin up. pinging SRE oncall.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1719001234 - GPU_POOL_PREEMPTION spike detected - pool=spot-us-west2 - preempt_rate=62% over 5m - queue_length=8200 - throttle_triggered=true - fallback_available=insufficient

Raj P: seeing same in dashboard, 95th latency > 18s, many requests in queued state. autoscaler shows maxNodes reached for spot pool and fallback pool is only 2 nodes.

Sophia L: stack traces point to eviction churn — lots of pods restarting due to node preemptions, KV cache warmup is killing us when nodes come up slowly.

Emma (infra): checked autoscaler logs: ``error: quotaExceeded: requested: 50, permitted: 20`` — we hit project quota when trying to provision on-demand fallback VMs.

Carlos (ops lead): severity=P0. Customer-impact: embeddings and similarity search for three top customers degraded, we have support tickets for timeouts. Noah, can you compile an ASAP impact matrix?

Noah (support): on it. Early notes: two top-100 customers reporting timeouts in prod for vector search. Ops ticket IDs: OPS-9871, OPS-9872. Notifying account teams.

Mia K: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily reroute traffic to eu fallback region; 2) increase on-demand fallback pool size (if quota allows); 3) scale down batch size and enable aggressive cold-cache responses (degrades quality but reduces tokens). Which can we run now?

Raj P: we can flip routing at the gateway level to send non-critical flow to eu-west2 in ~6m, but that will add 60-120ms cross-region latency. We need to preserve SLO for small subset only.

Emma (infra): quota increase from cloud console will take ~30-60m with emergency phone request. We can request emergency on-call quota bump but not guaranteed. Meanwhile we can spin up lower-tier GPU VMs (p4-small-equivalent) in us-west2 on-demand — provisioning ~4-7m per instance.

Sophia L: recommend immediate hybrid: route 30% of low-priority traffic to eu-west2, and start 4 on-demand nodes in us-west2 to drain the queue. Also set autoscaler maxNodes to a temporary higher value (patching HPA/cluster-autoscaler config).

Carlos (ops lead): authorize spinning 6 on-demand nodes now and patch maxNodes. Also escalate quota with cloud support, call if needed. Raj, coordinate routing change with deploy-bot and edge team.

Raj P: kicking off routing change: ``/run deploy-bot route-update --service embeddings --region us-west2 --split 70/30 --target eu-west2``. deploy-bot will post updates.

deploy-bot: executing route-update job #4532 - applying split 70/30 - estimated completion 00:06:00 - will monitor for 5m post-apply.

incident-bot: [ACTION] create bridge audio channel? Reaction :phone: requested by Carlos (ops lead).

Carlos (ops lead): starting bridge — dialing oncall and infra.

Emma (infra): provisioning on-demand VMs: issuing command: ``gcloud compute instances create gpu-on-demand-ephemeral-1 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --zone=us-west2-b --machine-type=n1-standard-16``. Tracking logs... first instance booting.

Mia K: monitoring queue: had 8200, now 30% routed away gives effective load drop to ~5600, new nodes coming should reduce queue more. Keep throttles on for the highest-cost endpoints to avoid token explosion.

Noah (support): updating customers: short note to affected customers that we're actively mitigating, expected partial recovery within 10-30m.

Raj P: autoscaler config patched: ``cluster-autoscaler.maxNodes: spot-pool=70 -> 90 (temp)``. Applied via infra pipeline. Watch for quota errors.

Sophia L: watchpoint — KV cache miss penalty when new nodes come up will temporarily spike latency still. We should enable prefix caching fallback: ``REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=true`` for embeddings workers to accept slightly stale cache and reduce warmup ops.

Emma (infra): quota escalation placed (case CLOUD-321229) — urgent phone queued. Meanwhile all 6 on-demand instances are running and joined cluster. Node registration time ~5m.

incident-bot: [METRIC] queue_length drop from 8200 -> 4100 in 9m. preempt_rate now 28% - still elevated.

Mia K: good sign. Next steps: 1) keep split 70/30 for 15m then reevaluate; 2) keep quota escalation open; 3) follow up with accounts for credits; 4) postmortem owner?

Carlos (ops lead): assigning postmortem to Sophia L. Expected initial incident summary in 2h. Action items logged to REDWOOD-INC-2026.

Noah (support): customers updated with ETA 45m for full recovery and interim workaround link.

Raj P: unscheduled but important: propose we add an emergency runbook for preemption waves w/ immediate steps: routing split, emergency on-demand spinup, cache-ltuning, and throttling knobs.

Sophia L: agreed, will draft runbook and include playbook to request quota emergency. Also include metrics to monitor: preempt_rate, queued_requests, avg_latency, fallback_node_count.

incident-bot: [RESOLVE CHECK] queue_length stabilized < 800 after 35m. Recommend de-escalation if no regressions in 15m.

Mia K: leaving bridge open for 15m for monitoring. Great work team. Followup: Sophia to own postmortem, Emma to own quota escalation follow-through, Raj to own routing runbook, Noah to manage customer comms.

Carlos (ops lead): closing incident as P0->P1 after stabilization. Will re-open if metrics regress. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
